name: Sandvik AB (publ)
research_rationale: Q3 2026 interim and news confirm strong earnings and a FOCF rebound, but softer orders and a fading tungsten tooling boost keep cyclical risks on the screen buy case.

weekly_updates.summary:
22 Oct Q3 2026 interim and press: strong profit (EPS SEK 4.6; adjusted EBITA margin cited ~22.5%), but orders eased quarter on quarter as a tungsten margin lift at tooling is set to fade.  
Quarterly cashflow in the refresh set shows Q3 FOCF ~SEK 6.2bn after a weak Q2; TTM FCF remains solid in the screen snapshot.  
Northern Star mining-equipment order (Oct) and valuation/momentum commentary; machining leadership change flagged in news only.
